settings.question: How does the card work?
settings.answer: There's an NFC chip inside the card, programmed with your Google review link. When a customer holds their phone near the card, their phone reads the chip and opens your Google review page — the same technology as tap-to-pay.

settings.question: Do my customers need an app?
settings.answer: No. NFC reading is built into modern iPhones and Android phones. Customers just unlock their phone and hold it near the card — no app, no QR code, no typing.

settings.question: How do you program my review link?
settings.answer: At checkout you'll enter your business name and Google review link. We program the chip, tap-test it on both iPhone and Android, and ship it ready to use. Nothing to set up on your end.

settings.question: What's the difference between Counter and Bulk cards?
settings.answer: Counter Cards are the bigger, premium card built to live on your counter or station. Bulk Cards are smaller and simpler, priced to hand out with bills, receipts, and takeout bags. Both are programmed with the same Google review link.

settings.question: What if I don't know my Google review link?
settings.answer: No problem. Order anyway and email us at sales@optiqservice.com — we'll send you a 2-minute guide to finding it, or find it for you if you share your business name and city.

settings.question: Are there any monthly fees?
settings.answer: No. Cards are a one-time purchase. Membership is a separate, optional add-on for businesses that want free replacements and monthly restocks — you never need it to use your card.

settings.question: Which phones does it work with?
settings.answer: Virtually all iPhones and Android phones from the last several years support tap-to-read NFC out of the box. If a customer has a much older phone, they can still find you on Google the usual way.

settings.question: Does it guarantee 5-star reviews?
settings.answer: No — and nothing legitimately can. What the card does is remove the friction: instead of asking customers to search for your business and find the review button, one tap takes them straight there. What they write is entirely up to them.
